cohort: The study included 175 pregnant women with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) and 162 healthy pregnant women matched for gestational age.
finding: Pregnant women with ICP exhibited significantly higher fibrinogen levels, an increased risk of postpartum venous thromboembolism, and a higher incidence of fetal complications including lower gestational age at delivery, fetal distress, meconium aspiration, preterm labor, and fetal growth restriction.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery for ICP patients was 253.75 ± 15.53 days, and for the control group was 271.43 ± 10.26 days.
